title: Decision No 1/2026 of the Joint Committee of 2 June 2026 on the amendments to Part A of Annex I and to Annex II to the Agreement between the European Union and Iceland on the protection of geographical indication for agricultural products and foodstuffs [2026/1370]

L series

DECISION No 1/2026 OF THE JOINT COMMITTEE
of 2 June 2026
on the amendments to Part A of Annex I and to Annex II to the Agreement between the European Union and Iceland on the protection of geographical indication for agricultural products and foodstuffs [2026/1370]
THE JOINT COMMITTEE,
Having regard to the Agreement between the European Union and Iceland on the protection of geographical indications for agricultural products and foodstuffs  ( 1 ) (hereinafter referred to as ‘the Agreement’), and in particular Article 3 thereof,
Whereas:
(1)
Pursuant to Article 10(3) of the Agreement, the Joint Committee may amend Part A of Annex I to the Agreement as regards the references to the law applicable on the Parties’ territories and Annex II to the Agreement as regards geographical indications.
(2)
The Joint Committee examined the proposed revised list of applicable legislation in the Union territory set out in Part A of Annex I to the Agreement.
(3)
The Joint Committee also examined the list of newly registered geographical indications proposed for inclusion in Annex II to the Agreement, as well as proposed corrections and removals of names that are currently listed in that Annex but are no longer protected in the Parties’ territories.
(4)
The Parties completed their examination and the internal procedures necessary for adoption of the Decision by the Joint Committee under the Agreement.
(5)
Part A of Annex I and Annex II to the Agreement should therefore be amended,
HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
Article 1
Part A of Annex I and Annex II to the Agreement between the European Union and Iceland on the protection of geographical indication for agricultural products and foodstuffs are replaced by the text in the Annex to this Decision.
Article 2
This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its adoption.
Done at Brussels, 2 June 2026.
For the Joint Committee
Iðunn María GUðJÓNSDÓTTIR
Embassy of Iceland in Brussels
Co-chair of the Joint Committee
Frank BOLLEN
Directorate-General for Agriculture and Rural Development of the European Commission
Co-chair of the Joint Committee
